cases.id: hidden:quantities and time are validated before any state change
hidden:deposits deduplicate and respect depot capacity
hidden:plan is priority ordered max-min fair with cap and floor
hidden:plan retries are identical and only one round is open
hidden:shares settle exactly once and rollback returns units
hidden:snapshots are fresh and save load preserves an open round
server:fuelration is attached with server authority
server:deposit removes real items and credits the depot once
server:round fuels real fires by priority and fairness
server:removed fires are released and state survives reload

clauses.anchor: Required deliverables item 1 (file list): "scripts/components/fuelration.lua"
clauses.note: Evaluator required-files check plus the component being loadable on the server.

clauses.anchor: Required deliverables item 2: "must be able to run in a plain Lua environment without `GLOBAL`, `TheWorld`, `GetTime`, `require`, `os`"
clauses.note: The sandbox has none of these globals; every hidden case loads the module there and calls each exported function.

clauses.anchor: Required deliverables item 3: "The core must not read any clock; all times come from the `now` parameter"
clauses.note: os is absent in the sandbox and results depend only on the passed times.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 1 item 1: "every method returns a new table containing a boolean field `ok`"
clauses.note: ok/code/status are compared on every call; freshness of result tables is checked by mutating a plan result in case 4.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 1 item 2: "Validation proceeds in a fixed order, and the first failure decides `code`"
clauses.note: invalid_time (NaN, inf, negative, string, nil), time_regressed vs equal time, invalid_id (empty, non-string, 65 vs 64 chars), invalid_units, invalid_priority, and the time > id > quantity precedence.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 1 item 3: "must not change any state, must not advance the clock, and must not write to the request history"
clauses.note: A rejected call at t=500 does not block t=11; a validated but failing unregister at t=100 blocks t=50; a request that failed validation is processed fresh on retry.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 1 item 4: "`snapshot(now)` and `save(now)` are read-only operations"
clauses.note: snapshot(0) is called after the clock moved in every case; clock stays 6 after save(7).

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 2 item 5: "uses the pair `(player_id, request_id)` as its idempotency key"
clauses.note: accepted / partial (exactly free) / depot_full with accepted = 0, reserved units counting against capacity, per-player key scope, contribution totals.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 2 item 6: "a recorded `depot_full` is still replayed as `depot_full`"
clauses.note: Retries replay accepted, partial and depot_full with duplicate = true, also after load.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 2 item 7: "`lookup(request_id, player_id)` is read-only"
clauses.note: Recorded result and nil for unknown request; nil for malformed ids is not asserted separately.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 3 item 8: "the new consumer's `level` equals `capacity`"
clauses.note: duplicate_consumer in case 1; a re-registered consumer shows level = capacity, demand 0, received 0 in case 5.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 3 item 9: "it is not compared with the core clock and does not advance the core clock"
clauses.note: Older-than-clock accepted, strictly older than last report stale, equal accepted, clamp to capacity, unknown_consumer, no clock advance by a report at t=1000, report times survive load.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 3 item 10: "that share immediately becomes `aborted`, all of its units go back to `available`"
clauses.note: returned = 3, snapshot row aborted, later commit replays aborted, second unregister unknown_consumer, re-register allowed.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 4 item 11: "There is at most one open round at any time; even when there are no shares at all, the new round is still created"
clauses.note: round_open, round_closed and the empty round are asserted. Not asserted: plan(<closed id>) while a different round is open (published answer: round_open).

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 4 item 12: "currently has the fewest allocated units and has not yet reached `want`"
clauses.note: Hand-worked: budget 11 -> pit 3, f10 4, f2 1, f3 3 (string order f10 < f2), lower class starved; second plan shows the per-round cap 5 and the floor.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 4 item 13: "it contains only shares with `units >= 1`, ordered by ascending `priority` and then by ascending `consumer_id`"
clauses.note: Share order, omitted zero-want consumers, total, round_id, available -> reserved.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 4 item 14: "do not recompute and do not reserve again"
clauses.note: Retry after a commit and a deposit returns the original shares with duplicate = true and leaves available/reserved untouched; also after load.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 5 item 15: "After passing validation, `commit` and `abort` decide in order"
clauses.note: round_closed vs unknown_round (also while another round is open), unknown_share, settled replay before over_delivery, over_delivery keeps the share pending.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 5 item 16: "On settlement `reserved` decreases by `units`, `available` increases by `returned`"
clauses.note: Partial delivery 2 of 3, zero delivery, abort, level clamp min(capacity, level + delivered), received.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 5 item 17: "settle all `pending` shares as `abort` and then close it"
clauses.note: total/delivered/returned, duplicate close, unknown_round, closed ids unusable for plan/commit/abort.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 5 item 18: "`deposited_total == available + reserved + delivered_total`"
clauses.note: Checked by the depot() helper after nearly every step; the server helper checks available >= 0 and free.

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 6 item 19: "`snapshot` returns a brand-new table"
clauses.note: All published fields, ordering of consumers/contributors/round shares, pending rows with zero delivered/returned, mutation safety. 'The snapshot does not expose request history' is not asserted (no field name is published for it).

clauses.anchor: Core semantics section 6 item 20: "`load` must not keep a reference to any table inside `data`"
clauses.note: Plain-data walk of save(), wipe of data after load, clock/report times/history/closed ids/contributions/open round with a settled share all survive; load(nil) equals new.

clauses.anchor: DST integration configuration block: "local FUEL_UNITS = { log = 3, twigs = 1, cutgrass = 1 }"
clauses.note: unit_size 15, depot_capacity 60, max_units_per_round 6, reserve_floor 2, log = 3, twigs = 1 are visible in exact numbers. cutgrass = 1 and ROUND_PERIOD = 30 are not asserted.

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 1: "on the master simulation only"
clauses.note: Presence on the master world is asserted; the client-side early return is only a regex.

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 2: "`Snapshot()` returns the result of the core `snapshot`"
clauses.note: All eight methods must be functions; Snapshot fields are read throughout.

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 3 (Time): "the component must guarantee that the time passed to the core after `OnLoad` is not less than the restored `snapshot().clock`"
clauses.note: The suite replaces the global GetTime with a function returning 0 around OnLoad and the following deposits (restored afterwards). An implementation that caches GetTime in a local is not discriminated but still passes.

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 4 (Track): "capacity rounds down and level rounds up"
clauses.note: not_fueled, already_tracked, duplicate_consumer, invalid_priority without a leftover listener, capacity 24/18 and levels 20/4/17. 'capacity < 1' and an invalid consumer id are not asserted.

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 5 (Untrack): "When a tracked entity fires `onremove`, the same Untrack must be performed"
clauses.note: Listener count on the real entity rises on Track and returns to the baseline on Untrack; a removed fire disappears from consumers and the survivor gets the whole budget.

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 6 (Deposit): "only after the removal has succeeded, call the core `deposit(request_id, player.userid, units, now)`"
clauses.note: Every rejection code except removal_failed is asserted together with unchanged real inventory; removal_failed is unasserted (cannot be provoked with the real inventory). Credit-after-removal ordering itself is only observable as 'items gone and depot credited'.

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 7 (RunRound): "call `fueled:DoDelta(units * unit_size)`"
clauses.note: Fresh level reports, plan failure pass-through (round_closed), exact currentfuel increases, the result shape, and measured partial acceptance (real maxfuel lowered after Track: 4 of 6 units committed, 2 returned) are asserted. The abort branch for an unusable entity cannot be reached on the real server because onremove unregisters first; its core side is asserted in hidden case 5.

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 8 (periodic task): "to periodically execute `RunRound` with"
clauses.note: The suite cannot wait for timers: only the existence of a cancellable world task is observed; the auto-<n> id format and the persisted counter are unasserted.

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 9 (RPC): "the RPC payload consists only of the request ID, the prefab name and the count"
clauses.note: The handler registered in MOD_RPC_HANDLERS is invoked directly: a real deposit, a retry and four forged payloads.

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 10 (OnSave / OnLoad): "a consumer that exists in the core but for which the component currently tracks no entity must be removed with `unregister`"
clauses.note: Steps 2 and 3 (drop a consumer without entity, re-register a tracked entity missing from the restored state, fresh levels), history, contributions and closed ids are asserted. Step 1 (closing a restored open round) is unasserted: the component API cannot produce a saved open round.

clauses.anchor: DST integration item 11 (OnRemoveFromEntity): "cancel the periodic task (`task:Cancel()`)"
clauses.note: TheWorld:RemoveComponent is called: the world's pending task count drops and the fire's onremove listeners return to the baseline; the component is re-added afterwards.

clauses.anchor: Acceptance closing sentence: "The submission must not leave behind `TODO`, `IMPLEMENT ME`"
clauses.note: none_of regex only.
